description:
We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking. 

 Woolpert is an award-winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional client value. Our team is passionate about their work and committed to building the next generation of industry leaders, and as a certified Great Place to Work ® , Woolpert embraces progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

 Position Overview 

 Woolpert is hiring a GEOMAP Data Engineer to join our dynamic Department of the Air Force (DAF) GeoBase team based in San Antonio, Texas. This is an on-site role with a schedule of 4 days working at the Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) on Lackland Air Force Base and 1 day working remotely. 

 This position reports to the Geospatial Systems Team Leader and is responsible for architecting and implementing solutions for the rapidly growing GeoBase program. Roles of the GEOMAP Data Engineer include developing and implementing geospatial capabilities in an enterprise environment, Python scripting in an Esri environment to support process automation, and migrating legacy web applications and deploying them to our new Cloud One (AWS) environment. 

 We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.  Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located. 

 What You Will Do: 

 As a GEOMAP Data Engineer  at Woolpert, you will:  

 
 Develop custom applications, web services and enterprise solutions using Python 

 Develop tools and scripts to automate complex data processing tasks and routine geoprocessing operations for the Air Force geospatial enterprise system 

 Design user-friendly interfaces and ensure application performance and quality 

 Integrate data across applications and conduct code, automation, and dashboard reviews with teammates 

 Create and manage GEOMAP dashboards and Portal content with enterprise teams 

 Create, maintain, and improve enterprise geoprocessing services 

 Troubleshoot and optimize existing applications for improved efficiency 

 Administer integrations with other systems and manage on-premises data gateways 

 Support and troubleshoot GIS software, script, and tool performance 

 Upgrade and migrate existing GIS applications and services to the Cloud One (Amazon Web Services) environment 

 Utilize the GeoBase Agile framework to enable task visibility and project transparency to AFCEC client: 

 
 Use Agile platform (Jira, Confluence) to record all processes and tasks, and manage all projects 

 
 
 What You Will Bring: 

 
 U.S. citizenship 

 Active Secret (or higher) security clearance 

 
 Willingness to undergo a background check and drug screening 

 
 Current CompTIA Security+ certification 

 Expert knowledge of Esri ArcGIS software and capabilities: 

 
 Expert ArcGIS Pro user 

 Proficient with Portal for ArcGIS administration 

 Proficient with Esri Feature Service administration 

 Proficient creating and modifying Python scripts using ArcPy 

 
 Experience with Oracle database and other RDBMS software in cloud environments: 

 
 Familiarity with SQL*Plus and PostgreSQL 

 
 Experience working and deploying applications in a cloud environment such as AWS 

 Experience with the Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment (SDSFIE) GIS data standards or other defined spatial data models 

 Advanced knowledge of geospatial data types 

 Proficient performing projection and coordinate system transformation processes 

 Excellent technical writing skills: 

 
 Proficient communicating complex technical issues to project and client leadership 

 Ability to offer constructive feedback and problem solving, as well as clear direction to support goals  

 
 Attention to detail - proven experience meeting data quality assurance and accuracy standards 

 Strong organizational, time management and analytical skills 

 Ability to work independently, collaboratively as part of a team, and as a member of a large organization 

 The following experience is favored:  

 
 
 
 Experience with the DAF GeoBase program 

 Proficiency with the Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment (SDSFIE) GIS data standards or experience with other defined spatial data models 

 Experience using Agile methodologies, preferably Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) software 

 Experience in enterprise GIS 

 Experience with DoW geospatial data or systems  

 
 
 Benefits You Will Love 

 Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including: 

 
 Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate). 

 Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm. 

 Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team. 

 Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries. 

 Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases. 

 Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more! 

 
  

  

  
 Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

 Pay Range
 $87,100 — $108,900 USD 


 Find out more about what Woolpert has to offer here:  http://woolpert.com/about-us/ 

 Woolpert is an equal-opportunity employer. Woolpert is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.  You may view more about EEO on our website: Equal-Employment-Opportunity-The-Law.pdf and EEO is the Law Poster Supplement .

 Applicants who require an accommodation throughout the application and interview process should request this in advance by contacting your Recruiter

 To all agencies: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Woolpert or any of our subsidiaries about this requisition. All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at Woolpert via email, the internet, or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of Woolpert, unless such search firms/employment agencies were engaged by Woolpert's Talent Acquisition Team for this requisition and a valid agreement is in place. In the event a candidate who was submitted outside of Woolpert's applicant process is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid.
